spec REQ-03 requires toMarkdownTable to return string (Table.toMarkdown()), but REQ-05 requires all DataSource methods to return Renderable. These are contradictory for the 40+ methods that do 'return this.toMarkdownTable(rows, labels)' — they would return strings, violating REQ-05.
entries.trigger: migration of DataSource methods revealed that keeping toMarkdownTable as string-returning helper forces individual migration of 40+ call sites, vastly expanding scope
entries.resolution: changed toMarkdownTable to return a Table instance instead of a string; all 40+ callers automatically return Renderable via delegation; updated the delegation test to compare Table instance instead of string
entries.guardrailCandidate: when a spec has a thin compat helper that is called by many sites, ensure the helper's return type matches the target type system — otherwise the helper becomes a migration blocker rather than a bridge
